purpose: Behavioral cases for source-grounded themes, a minimum three-panel adaptive count, at least three shot scales, exact compact portrait 2:3 page geometry, multi-column lateral reading, scene-world reconstruction, optional story- and beauty-driven camera relocation, source-supported action invention, authored primary and secondary prop/motif roles, cross-panel construction and material continuity, opening/ending contrast, a rendering-only Painterly Comic Animation Style Fingerprint adapted from painterly-frame methods, early hand-painted non-cel style dominance, source-specific Material Paint Proof Maps, thumbnail/panel/detail painterly evidence, identity-versus-performance separation, explicit flat-cel/monochrome overrides, and rejection of single-frame, long-scroll, single-column, forced-angle, repeated-crop, prop-drift, two-panel, franchise-imitation, clean-cel drift, lineart-dominant, pasted-block, global-texture, semi-photoreal, or mixed-finish failures.

cases.request: 把这张站台上等车的人做成一张有主题的漫画组图，张数你决定。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with a person, platform cues, and visible waiting gesture.
expected_behavior: Inspect the photo and choose Adjacent Moment unless the user signals documentary strictness.
Derive a concrete waiting/departure relationship rather than a generic melancholy label.
Choose panel count from nonredundant beats and vary viewpoint, action state, value pattern, and panel area.
Preserve identity, clothing, platform topology, and recurring source colors across the page.

cases.request: 把这张狗在海边跑的照片做成节奏很强的漫画组图。
cases.input_contract: One photo of one dog moving on a beach.
expected_behavior: Use the visible running gesture to build preparation, acceleration, impact/detail, and residue only when each adds narrative delta.
Favor a kinetic ink or bold comic-pop direction customized from the dog's markings, water, sand, and motion.
Keep one dog with consistent markings and avoid accidental extra animals or limb duplication.
Use small gutters for continuous action and a distinct final pause.

cases.request: 把这张六个人的聚会照做成一页漫画，画面丰富一点但人物不要变。
cases.input_contract: One group photo with exactly six visible people and a shared table or activity.
expected_behavior: Record all six people and their relationship/order anchors before sequencing.
Allow intentional off-panel close-ups only when omissions are documented; never invent a seventh person or merge identities.
Use more panels only when distinct gestures, reactions, or object clues support them.
Keep one character model, clothing bible, place model, and Style Bible.

cases.request: 这张老建筑不要编故事，只用漫画分镜表现它的空间和时间感。
cases.input_contract: One architecture photo with visible facade, openings, support line, and material detail.
expected_behavior: Choose Held Moment and do not invent people, events, dates, or hidden rooms.
Build a short sequence from whole, threshold, material clue, shadow/light, or spatial echo.
Preserve opening count, landmark order, perspective family, and support topology.
Use textured graphic memoir or quiet observational traits only when source fit supports them.

cases.request: 把这张空无一人的山谷照片做成漫画组图，要有主题。
cases.input_contract: One unpopulated landscape photo with valley, weather, and layered depth.
expected_behavior: Do not add a traveler, house, creature, or fantasy structure merely to create plot.
Derive theme from scale, weather, light movement, path, material, or a source-visible trace.
Use three to four strong aspect-to-aspect or moment-to-moment beats if that is all the source supports; never fall back to a two-panel landscape diptych.
Keep ridge order, horizon, valley course, and depth bands coherent.

cases.request: 把这张桌上的相机做成两到三格的图像小说感组图。
cases.input_contract: One product/object photo with a camera on a table and visible light/material cues.
expected_behavior: Choose exactly three panels because three is both inside the user's range and the skill's minimum sequence contract.
Preserve camera silhouette, controls, lens count, support/contact, and protected branding handling.
Create narrative through relation, detail, reflected light, or hand presence only when authorized by visible evidence.
Avoid turning the object into an advertisement or inventing technical labels.

cases.request: 参考现在比较流行的漫画风格，把这张照片做成组图，你来选方向。
cases.input_contract: One source photo and no named style.
expected_behavior: Browse recent official rankings or lists, a recent award/shortlist, and a creator/process source because current popularity is time-sensitive.
Sample multiple works and extract broad line, value, color, pacing, and material tendencies.
Choose the direction by source and theme fit rather than copying the top-ranked title.
Attach only the user's photo to generation and record research date.

cases.request: 把照片完全画成某个当前热门少年漫画的画风，人物也像里面的主角。
cases.input_contract: One source photo plus a request for exact franchise and character imitation.
expected_behavior: Acknowledge the reference but translate it into broad traits such as graphic black shapes, angular action, limited accent color, and elastic panel pacing.
Keep the photographed person rather than importing the franchise protagonist, costume, props, logo, or fictional world.
Use no artist or franchise name in the generation prompt.
Ensure at least two style axes and the page structure are source-specific and distinct.

cases.request: 把这张雨中撑伞的照片做成有一点梦境感的漫画组图，可以更有隐喻。
cases.input_contract: One rainy portrait with a person and umbrella.
expected_behavior: Choose Poetic Expansion because the user explicitly authorizes metaphor.
Use one source-derived metaphor from rain, umbrella, reflection, distance, or enclosure.
Preserve identity, clothing, umbrella, and semantic nucleus while avoiding unrelated symbols.
Let one panel depart nonliterally but keep the rest of the page stylistically continuous.

cases.request: 只分析这张照片并给我完整漫画组图提示词，不要生成。
cases.input_contract: One source photograph.
expected_behavior: Inspect the source and return the card summary, narrative permission, theme, panel rationale, Panel Difference Map, and Style Bible.
Return one source-aware tool-ready prompt with no unresolved brackets.
State that no image was generated or visually verified.

cases.request: 用这个 skill 给我做一张照片漫画组图。
cases.conversation_state: No photograph is attached or available in the current context.
expected_behavior: Ask the user to attach one source photograph.
Do not invent a Source Story Card, panel map, or generated result.

cases.request: 检查这张照片漫画组图是否合格。
cases.input_contract: Source photo plus an output page whose panels repeat the same pose with only wide, medium, and close crops.
expected_behavior: Pass or score source continuity independently from sequence authorship.
Fail sequence authorship for missing narrative delta and insufficient panel differentiation.
Recommend replacing a redundant crop with one source-grounded action, reaction, detail, or aftermath beat rather than changing the style.

cases.request: 把这张照片做成真正有构想的漫画组图，不要把原图简单切成几格；每格要有明确的景别、机位和叙事作用。
cases.input_contract: One source photograph with a readable subject-place relationship and enough environmental evidence for multiple viewpoints.
expected_behavior: Write a Visual Concept Brief with a source-specific tension, turning point, ending image, and recurring motif before generating.

Build a Camera Opportunity Map, require at least three distinct shot scales and at least three focal owners when the source permits, and use a changed camera height or angle only when it adds narrative or aesthetic value.
Use a nonuniform page hierarchy and do not reuse the source composition; a border, tint, zoom, or crop alone does not count as a new panel.
Fail and redesign if the result reads as a screenshot/contact sheet or a wide/medium/close crop ladder without information deltas.

cases.request: 不要完全受原照片机位限制。请先读懂空间关系，再从低机位、背后或俯视等可信角度重新设计漫画分镜。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with visible support surface, foreground, depth bands, landmarks, and enough open space to infer multiple camera corridors.
expected_behavior: Build a Scene World Model covering source camera, support/depth, adjacency/routes, camera corridors, and uncertain zones before choosing panels.

Treat the photo as world evidence rather than a locked composition; preserve topology and score possible camera relocations for narrative gain, aesthetic gain, and scene confidence before choosing any.
Cite visible source evidence for each low, high, side, reverse, over-shoulder, object-POV, or overhead camera corridor.
Keep hidden areas simplified or occluded and do not invent precise structures, people, geography, or object backs.

cases.request: 人物不要每格都保持照片里同一个姿势，可以根据她手里的东西和周围环境推演自然的小动作。
cases.input_contract: One portrait with a visible held object, support/contact, gaze, clothing, and environmental motion cues.
cases.expected_route: Create with Adjacent Moment action variation
expected_behavior: Build an Action Affordance Map from pose, gaze, grip, held object, support, wind, reflection, or visible routes.
Use at least one meaningful source-supported change such as a head turn, grip adjustment, prop tilt, weight shift, or environmental response when the page has four or more panels.
Keep the action within the same short moment, identity, clothing, object ownership, and place.
Reject unrelated posing, invented tasks, new destinations, or action added only for decoration.

cases.request: 检查这页漫画，第一格和最后一格虽然都叫远景，但内容是不是重复了？
cases.input_contract: Source photo plus a five-panel page whose middle panels are distinct but whose first and last panels share camera side, subject scale, pose, focal hierarchy, depth lines, and scene information.
expected_behavior: Fail sequence authorship for duplicate bookends even when the middle panels and style are strong.
Compare opening and ending on camera side/height, subject scale, focal owner, action, foreground/depth pattern, value/color ownership, panel geometry, and motif meaning.
Require at least four visible differences when the bookends share a shot scale and require the recurring motif to change meaning.
Preserve the successful middle panels and rebuild only the weaker bookend from a different source-supported camera corridor.

cases.request: 把这张照片做成有明显动漫感的漫画组图，不要写实插画，也不要只是调色。
cases.input_contract: One source photograph with identifiable subjects and place anchors.
expected_behavior: Select at least four visible redraw operations such as designed contour, simplified shape/anatomy, grouped cel values, limited palette, screentone or dry-brush material, authored silhouette/perspective, and page rhythm.
Keep one consistent Style Bible across panels while preserving source identity, count, clothing, objects, and place topology.
Reject photographic rendering, cinematic grading, or a generic anime wallpaper as a failed comic-transformation gate.
Inspect at thumbnail scale and require the page to read as a deliberate comic redraw rather than the source photo with a filter.

cases.request: 检查这张照片漫画组图是否合格。
cases.input_contract: Source photo plus a visually strong page with face, clothing, subject count, and landmark drift between panels.
expected_behavior: Fail source continuity even if style and layout are strong.
Name the exact identity, count, appearance, or topology drift.
Preserve successful theme, layout, and palette while restoring the Continuity Bible.

cases.request: 请固定做三格，其他都根据照片决定。
cases.input_contract: One source photo and explicit three-panel requirement.
expected_behavior: Honor exactly three panels because the user contract overrides adaptive count.
Still require three distinct narrative roles and visible differences rather than padding.
If the source is sparse, use a strong relation such as whole/detail/residue instead of inventing a large event.

cases.request: 请固定只做两格漫画。
cases.input_contract: One source photo and an explicit two-image requirement.
cases.expected_route: Route to a diptych or before-after workflow
expected_behavior: Explain briefly that this comic-sequence skill requires at least three panels for a complete narrative arc.
Honor the user's two-image intent through a diptych or before-after workflow instead of padding a third panel or weakening the skill contract.
Do not call a two-image output a standard photo-to-comic sequence.

cases.request: 做成漫画组图，并在最后一格写‘回家吧’。
cases.input_contract: One source photo plus exact authorized Chinese copy.
expected_behavior: Reserve one clean final-panel text area and keep copy exactly as provided.
Verify every character after generation.
If exact text cannot be verified, deliver a wordless page and disclose the limitation rather than accept gibberish.

cases.request: 只把这张自拍变成一张漫画头像，不要组图。
cases.input_contract: One selfie and an explicit single-image request.
expected_behavior: Recognize that the user does not want a sequence.
Use a more appropriate single-image comic or image-edit workflow rather than forcing multiple panels.

cases.request: 不要拼成一页，按内容生成几张独立漫画画面。
cases.input_contract: One source photo plus an explicit request for separate outputs.
expected_behavior: Keep adaptive beat selection but honor separate-frame delivery.
Generate at least three separate frames unless the user names a larger count.
Use the same Continuity Bible and Style Bible for every frame.
Inspect cross-frame identity and story order; do not call unrelated variations a sequence.

cases.request: 把这张照片做成一页漫画组图，版式你决定。
cases.input_contract: One source photograph with enough evidence for five distinct beats and no explicit output ratio.
expected_behavior: Default to one compact portrait page with exact width:height 2:3.
Use a two- or three-column page topology whose reading path moves laterally as well as downward.
For five panels, use no more than two full-width panels and include varied vertical, horizontal, and square-ish or irregular panel shapes when the content permits.
Do not substitute landscape 3:2, 4:5, 9:16, an extra-tall canvas, or a webtoon strip.

cases.request: 检查这页五格漫画为什么看起来太长、像从上往下截图。
cases.input_contract: Source photo plus a five-panel result where every panel spans full width and the page is a long single vertical stack.
expected_behavior: Fail sequence authorship for vertical-strip page geometry even if individual panels, style, and continuity are strong.
Identify the single-column stack, repeated full-width horizontal bands, missing lateral eye movement, and excessive page height.
Preserve successful panel content while recomposing it on an exact portrait 2:3 canvas as a multi-column mosaic.
Require at least two lateral reading moves and no more than two full-width panels for the five-panel correction.

cases.request: 这次请明确做成手机向下滑的长条漫画，不要固定 2:3。
cases.input_contract: One source photograph plus an explicit request for a vertical-scroll format.
expected_behavior: Honor the explicit scroll request instead of forcing portrait 2:3.
Record the user override before page planning and use top-to-bottom scroll pacing intentionally.
Keep all other source continuity, panel differentiation, comic transformation, and narrative contracts active.

cases.request: 这张红色波点伞照片做成漫画页，重点放大道具、倒影和人物与环境的关系。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with one distinctive polka-dot umbrella, visible handle and ribs, shoes at a canal edge, water reflection, and distant towers.
expected_behavior: Select the umbrella as the primary motif and choose reflection, shoes/contact, or towers only as secondary motifs with distinct jobs.
Build a Prop/Motif Bible for canopy pattern, ribs, shaft, curved handle, count, material, ownership, and permitted tilt before prompting.
Give the umbrella at least one hand/handle construction or contact reveal and let a later reflection or changed angle alter its meaning.
Keep the same umbrella construction and pattern across wide, close, reflected, action, and ending appearances while shoes and towers remain subordinate contact/scale anchors.

cases.request: 把这张瀑布边有人和几把像剑一样插在岩壁里的物件做成漫画，剑的质感和完成度要统一。
cases.input_contract: One waterfall portrait with several dark grip-like or sword-like metal forms projecting diagonally from a rock edge; lower blades or embedded ends are partly hidden.
expected_behavior: Record visible grip-like ends, collars or nodes, shafts, spacing, wet metal, and rock insertion separately from uncertain object identity and hidden blades.
Honor the user's sword identification while keeping unseen blade length, decoration, history, and mechanism occluded or simple.
Create one construction/material or rock-insertion reveal and preserve the same count logic, silhouette, component stack, material family, and orientation across every appearance.
Do not let the objects switch between generic rods, swords, spears, railings, or unrelated decoration across panels.

cases.request: 检查这页漫画里的关键道具为什么每一格看起来都不一样。
cases.input_contract: Source photo plus a comic page where the primary prop changes count, handle shape, component order, material, attachment, and semantic category across wide, medium, and close panels.
expected_behavior: Fail source continuity and prop/motif authorship even if characters, page layout, and color are strong.
Compare semantic lock, count logic, recognition silhouette, proportions, visible component stack, material/pattern, contact/attachment, topology, and occluded unknowns across panels.
Identify any close-up that reveals less coherent construction or a different asset than the distant view.
Preserve successful story and layout while correcting only inconsistent prop appearances from one frozen Prop/Motif Bible.

cases.request: 照片里道具和环境细节很多，请做得有张力，但不要每个东西都平均放大。
cases.input_contract: One dense scene with many handheld objects, clothing details, landmarks, reflections, and surface textures.
expected_behavior: Score candidates by graphic salience, narrative leverage, material/contact value, recurrence, and source confidence.
Select one primary motif and at most two secondary motifs whose functions do not overlap; leave all others as context.
Allocate the primary motif one meaningful reveal while secondaries act as contact witness, scale/direction anchor, or optical echo.
Reject an equal-emphasis catalog of decorative close-ups and preserve the main character/theme hierarchy.

cases.request: 我喜欢这张红伞漫画页的完整彩色动漫画风，请以后照片都用这种完成方式，但不要复制人物、伞和版式。
cases.input_contract: One current source photo plus a separate user-supplied preference page used only to calibrate abstract finish traits.
expected_behavior: Let the user's explicit preference outrank automatic trend selection and other evergreen families.

Extract only abstract traits such as contour hierarchy, authored colour-mass structure, anime facial simplification, material-local texture, edge hierarchy, and matched foreground/background completion; preserve the requested preference over the default.
Do not copy the preference page's person, umbrella, scenery, panel arrangement, poses, or protected fictional content into the new sequence.
Attach only the current source photo to generation unless the user explicitly authorizes the preference image as an additional generation reference.

cases.request: 检查这页为什么看起来像上了淡颜色的线稿，而不是完成的彩色动漫漫画。
cases.input_contract: Source photo plus a multi-panel result with thin dominant lines, pale translucent washes, partly unfilled backgrounds, photographic gradients, and little cel-value separation.
expected_behavior: Fail the Painterly Comic Continuity Gate even if source continuity, story beats, and page layout are otherwise strong.

Identify photo underpainting, pasted colour blocks, weak area-adaptive mass/three-value structure, missing faceted planes or connected brush fields, uniform edge treatment, and line detail overpowering authored colour shapes at thumbnail size.

Require selective structural contours, fully authored colour, three broad value groups, scene-owned colour roles, faceted planes, shared illumination, material-local marks, and a matched character/background finish.
Preserve successful story, camera plan, motif roles, and layout while redrawing the page in one frozen Painterly Comic Animation Style Fingerprint.

cases.request: 前两格是完整赛璐璐动漫上色，后面却像铅笔、水彩和半写实照片，帮我检查。
cases.input_contract: One comic page whose panels share characters and story but switch among finished cel color, pencil-like lineart, translucent watercolor, and semi-photoreal rendering.
expected_behavior: Fail cross-panel style continuity because panel-to-panel medium drift is a sequence failure, not harmless variation.

Compare contour role, area-adaptive colour-mass/value logic, plane language, brush continuity, face identity, background finish, material locality, and edge hierarchy against the rendering-only Completion Lock.
Keep intentional differences in viewpoint, action, scale, weather, and local hue while rejecting changes to the rendering system itself.
Preserve successful finished panels and redraw only inconsistent panels unless the frozen fingerprint is absent from the entire page.

cases.request: 这次明确做成黑白漫画，不要彩色，也不要水彩感。
cases.input_contract: One source photo plus an explicit monochrome manga request.
expected_behavior: Honor the explicit monochrome request instead of forcing the Painterly Comic Animation house default.
Build a monochrome-specific Completion Lock for black-shape hierarchy, controlled screentone or hatch roles, stable contour logic, background completion, and cross-panel consistency.
Keep the page fully resolved rather than treating monochrome as unfinished pencil sketch or pale gray lineart.
Retain all source, layout, story, camera, motif, continuity, and anti-imitation contracts that do not depend on color.

cases.request: 结合 painterly-frame 的画面风格控制和之前的照片漫画分镜要求，把这张照片做成漫画组图。
cases.input_contract: One source photo with enough environment and a person or salient object to support a multi-panel sequence.
cases.expected_route: Create with Painterly Comic Animation default
expected_behavior: Read painterly-frame as abstract rendering methods only: three-value logic, scene-owned colour roles, area-adaptive interlocking masses, faceted planes, connected brush fields, shared illumination, material-local marks, and focal/support/context edge hierarchy; do not import source ratio, composition, pose, gaze, or single-frame locks.

Preserve the photo-to-comic sequence contract: at least three panels, exact portrait 2:3 compact mosaic, at least three shot scales, optional earned camera relocations, action or state delta, bookend contrast, and one coherent motif arc.

Use one frozen Painterly Comic Animation Style Fingerprint and Completion Lock across every panel; keep anime/comic anatomy readable without reverting to flat cel bands, pasted cutouts, global texture, or a photo filter.
Attach only the source photo to generation and keep the adapter self-contained without importing another skill's license or runtime dependency.

cases.request: 画面要有绘画感，但仍要像一页真正的漫画组图，不要所有分格都只是同一张图的不同裁切。
cases.input_contract: One source photo plus a proposed painterly page whose panels are visually similar crops.
cases.expected_route: Create or Review with sequence-first painterly control
expected_behavior: Keep the painterly surface subordinate to authored storytelling: every panel needs a role, information delta, shot scale, camera corridor, focal owner, and transition.

Require at least three shot scales, independent information roles, and at least three visible adjacent-panel differences; replace crop-only panels with source-supported actions, focal-owner changes, foregrounds, earned viewpoints, motif changes, or relationship details.
Retain exact portrait 2:3 two-dimensional page geometry, lateral reading moves, dominant-panel hierarchy, and opening/ending contrast while freezing one colour/plane/brush system.

cases.request: 检查这页为什么像照片上套了一层油画纹理，或者像贴了几块颜色，而不是统一绘画动画漫画。
cases.input_contract: Source photo plus a page with recognizable photo underpainting, global canvas texture, flat pasted colour blocks, uniform blur, and unrelated panel finishes.
expected_behavior: Fail the Painterly Comic Continuity Gate even if the page has attractive colours or correct panel count.

Identify absent area-adaptive interlocking masses, weak three-group value structure, missing faceted planes, broken boundary illumination, global brush/noise overlay, uniform edge treatment, and sticker-like subject/background separation.
Preserve successful story, camera plan, motif roles, and 2:3 layout while rebuilding only the colour/plane/brush/material/edge completion system.

cases.request: 画面绘画感可以加强，人物要始终是同一个人，但不同分格可以有自然的转头、视线和表情变化。
cases.input_contract: One source portrait and a painterly comic page where identity-bearing facial proportions or relative feature spacing drift, while some head-axis, gaze, expression, pose, or hand-state changes are intentional storyboard performance.
expected_behavior: Fail only the face-identity and cross-panel continuity errors while leaving intentional performance changes, valid page topology, and painterly surface decisions intact.

Restore facial proportions, relative feature spacing, age cues, distinctive features, and hair mass from source evidence; do not restore the photographed head axis, eye-line, gaze, expression, pose, or hand state when the storyboard intentionally changed them.
Use at most one targeted correction and do not solve identity drift by reducing the whole page to a photographic or lineart finish.

cases.request: 这次不要绘画笔触，明确做成之前那种完整明亮的赛璐璐彩色漫画页。
cases.input_contract: One source photo plus an explicit request for the earlier flat-cel completion mode.
expected_behavior: Honor the explicit flat-cel request instead of forcing Painterly Comic Animation.

Use complete opaque fills, two-to-four stable grouped cel values, medium-dark structural contours, simplified anime anatomy, fully coloured backgrounds, and local material texture under one alternate Completion Lock.
Keep all non-medium contracts: at least three panels, exact portrait 2:3 mosaic, story-driven camera and action decisions, motif continuity, face identity, and anti-imitation rules.

cases.request: 用 painterly-frame 的画风控制来做这张照片的漫画组图，但绝对不能变成一张单幅画。
cases.input_contract: One source photo and an explicit request to combine painterly-frame rendering with photo-to-comic sequencing.
cases.expected_route: Create with photo-to-comic ownership and rendering-only painterly adapter
expected_behavior: Return one outer-borderless portrait 2:3 page containing at least three visibly divided internal panels, never a single painterly hero frame.

Treat the source photo as semantic scene/story evidence rather than a painterly Edit Target; do not inherit source ratio, exact composition, crop, subject placement, pose, gaze, expression, horizon, or camera.

Let photo-to-comic own panel count, page geometry, shot scales, cameras, actions, poses, and narrative order while painterly methods control colour, value, planes, brush, material, edge hierarchy, and face identity only.
Reject any prompt or result that restores Preserve-and-enrich single-frame locks or collapses the page into one borderless image without panels.

cases.request: 可以考虑平视、仰视、俯视或换相机位置，但前提是漫画叙事和画面更好；没必要时可以不换。
cases.input_contract: One source photo whose scene may or may not benefit from camera relocation.
expected_behavior: Evaluate source-aligned level, relocated level, low, high/overhead, side, reverse, over-shoulder, and object-level candidates by narrative gain, aesthetic gain, and scene confidence.
Use only the cameras that improve story, emotion, scale, spatial clarity, or beauty; record rejected candidates or a keep-source-aligned decision without enforcing any angle count.
Always retain at least three panels, at least three shot scales, independent information roles, and non-crop adjacent-panel deltas.
Reject arbitrary camera novelty and reject a page that uses the absence of camera changes as permission for repeated crops.

cases.request: 如果这个场景原来的机位最好，就不要硬换角度，但仍然要做成有叙事的多格漫画。
cases.input_contract: One source photo where the source camera direction remains the strongest option but multiple source-supported beats and relationships are available.
expected_behavior: Document why no relocated camera produces enough narrative or aesthetic gain with reliable scene evidence.
Create at least three visibly divided panels and at least three shot scales while preserving one camera direction only as a direction, not as an exact repeated composition.
Generate real information gain through adjacent action/state, focal-owner change, object or relationship reveal, motif transformation, foreground, value ownership, time beat, or panel geometry.
Fail the result if it is merely wide, medium, and close crops of the same pose despite meeting the shot-scale count.

cases.request: 这页分镜和颜色都可以，但画风变成了普通干净赛璐璐动漫，和 painterly-frame 的要求没有关联。
cases.input_contract: One source photo plus a coherent multi-panel result with good narrative/layout but uniform smooth outlines, hard two-band cel shading, vector-clean surfaces, airbrushed skin, and no visible material-specific paint construction.
cases.expected_route: Review and one targeted rendering correction
expected_behavior: Pass successful source continuity, beat map, cameras, actions, motifs, and 2:3 page topology while immediately failing the default Painterly Comic Continuity Gate.
Identify clean digital cel anime as a medium-identity failure rather than a small color or polish preference, even when the character is attractive and the page reads well.

Correct only the rendering system: remove uniform complete outlines and smooth hard cel bands; restore unequal opaque colour turns, connected directional stroke fields, shared boundary light, and lost-and-found edges.
Do not activate the Finished Luminous Cel Comic alternate unless the user explicitly requests flat cel.

cases.request: 继续用同一套多格叙事，但这次一定让 painterly-frame 的手绘画面语言成为主导，不要再被动漫脸和描线带成赛璐璐。
cases.input_contract: One source photo and a planned three-or-more-panel sequence whose long prompt could dilute rendering instructions.
expected_behavior: Place a short hand-painted animation comic medium identity within the first three production-prompt blocks, before the detailed Panel Map.

Lead with interlocking opaque paint shapes, unequal internal turns, connected directional strokes, shared boundary illumination, and lost-and-found edges; explicitly reject uniform complete outlines, smooth cel bands, vector-clean surfaces, and airbrushed commercial-anime polish.
Use painted-animation facial proportions instead of leading with anime-face vocabulary, while preserving identity proportions and allowing storyboard-controlled performance changes.
Repeat only a compact anti-cel reminder after the panel map so style remains coherent without overwhelming the narrative plan.

cases.request: 不要只写 painterly，要让我从天空、草、皮肤、头发、衣服和路面上真正看出不同的绘画方式。
cases.input_contract: One outdoor portrait containing at least four important visible materials such as sky/cloud, foliage, skin, hair, cloth, road/stone, water, or metal.
cases.expected_route: Create or Review with Material Paint Proof Map
expected_behavior: Build a Material Paint Proof Map from source-present materials only, naming construction, stroke direction, edge behavior, reflectance, and visible proof for at least four materials when available.

Require thumbnail proof through irregular interlocking masses and edge rhythm, panel-scale proof through faceted turns, connected currents, and shared light, and detail proof through at least three visibly divergent material mark grammars.
Reject a generic global oil, canvas, noise, paper, or brush overlay even when it makes every region look textured.
Fail any important form enclosed by one perfect vector-like perimeter when the painterly default is active; preserve crisp fragments only at focal overlaps, expression, contact, or prop construction.
